target: User-supplied development BMC, Huawei BC83ETHA / SF221Q; openUBMC 25.06 / SDK 5.12.00.01

execution.path: DSH source profile -> trusted Host authority -> MCP -> real Python Runtime -> physical target
execution.driver: Scripted model selecting explicit qualification actions; not a real-model autonomy qualification

controlled_lost_reply.scope: Checksum-guarded removal of an independently created temporary file; restart_scope=none
controlled_lost_reply.injection: Drop the domain acknowledgement only after the real rollback journal is verified. Reject the first two recovery calls before domain inspection; permit the third.

retained_prior_trial.reason: Terminal journal replay omitted raw mutation/verification payloads; closeout did not recognize already-verified file absence. The source fix and a separate new trial establish completion; this historical failure was not rewritten.

limitations: The fault is deliberately injected after verified domain completion; it is not a physical network outage or an interruption in the middle of a device write.
Native Apply and explicit Rollback use a scripted qualification driver. Real-model autonomy and portable-host live execution are separate qualifications.
The target retains its existing NC-SI initialization errors and disconnected ports; these checks do not establish NIC repair.
No full component/product build, HPM upload, firmware activation or firmware rollback was performed.
